references.text: The same formula is used when the Lord speaks to Moses, a recurring phrase throughout Exodus that introduces divine revelation.
An identical introductory formula where the Lord addresses Moses with instructions for the people of Israel.
The same Hebrew expression 'וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר' is used to introduce God's speech to Moses.
A standard opening formula in Leviticus where the Lord communicates his laws and statutes through Moses.
The same introductory phrase that marks the beginning of divine communication to Moses in Numbers.
